$comment: FoodBlock 1.6 conformance vectors (spec/protocol.md, Conformance). Built by the reference SDK (sdk/javascript/test/make-vectors.cjs) from fixed seeds and times, every expectation written by hand and checked against the Rust core before this file is written; spec/run-vectors.cjs checks every section, and the oracle (spec/oracle), written from the spec text alone, checks it again. Test keys come from fixed seeds: never use them for anything real. Placeholder ids are sha256 of a label. A block in a story is { name, hash, signer, block: { type, state, refs }, signature } (and suite when it is not std); `signer` names a key in `keys`. Sections: keys; canonical; hashes (one block of every type) and ledger (its genesis blocks); audience; signatures; bad_signatures; envelopes; sealed; headers; identities; deals; circles; folds (promises, circles, audience, things, successors, rekeys, ballots); refusals (each case with the codes from protocol.json refusals.codes: by check, valid, accept, fold, may_act_as, under, open); messages; cbor (key table 1); door (an op of the core, its arguments, and what it gives: `expect` is a subset match, `codes` the refusal codes, `error` a failure; a case with oracle false is outside the spec text).
